scientific_integrity: The statement is proved by an explicit PL edge-orbit triangulation, path-conflict analysis, and an elementary suspension recurrence. Computational checks are bounded.
scientific_limitations: The assertion addresses common geometric fixed points of the coordinate-reflection Klein four-group, not every subgroup or ambient quotient.
The ambient three-row grid matching-complex wedge conjecture remains unproved.
The literature provides the row-reflection orbit split; the additional common fixed-point classification has a residual risk of being an unstated straightforward consequence in other work.
Finite verification supplements, not replaces, the proof. No independent mathematical audit performed.
title: Full reflection-fixed spaces of three-row grid matching complexes
